definitions.ask: On a blocked or missing preview, should `y` start a durable re-check proc that republishes the preview?
definitions.why: You expected a proc; transient gaps like project onboarding otherwise block pruning up to 1h

choices.label: y runs a re-check proc; adds `prune-runs --publish-preview` and one durable op
y only explains via toast; recovery waits for the next hourly preview
